title: Dr. Chris Knobbe - 'Diseases of Civilization: Are Seed Oil Excesses the Unifying Mechanism?'
summary: Ophthalmologist Chris Knobbe argues that excess omega-6 seed oils are a unifying cause of chronic diseases of civilization such as diabetes and macular degeneration. He presents the case at Low Carb Denver 2020.
why: HN commenters point to it in nutrition threads as the strongest case against seed oils, though it is a contested claim.

quote.text: I think the best talk of the health dangers of seed oils is in the following video
